title: Background CPU contention
description: A background process saturates a core for 1.4 s, starving the render thread.

events.title: Background CPU contention
events.whatHappened: One frame took 104 ms against a 6.9 ms baseline.
events.mechanism: The render thread was ready to submit work but had to wait for CPU time that another process was using. Clock speeds stayed high, so the machine was shared rather than slowed.
events.recommendedAction: Close or postpone the process with id 4812 while playing.

evidence.statement: Total CPU load rose 47 points to 88%
CPU effective clock held near 4.60 GHz throughout

ruledOut.title: CPU frequency collapse
ruledOut.reason: CPU effective clock stayed near 4.59 GHz.

ruledOut.title: GPU thermal throttling
ruledOut.reason: GPU peaked at 68 C with no thermal limit reported.

ruledOut.title: GPU power limit
ruledOut.reason: The GPU reported nothing as the reason for its clocks.

ruledOut.title: Storage stall
ruledOut.reason: Disk response time stayed at 0.5 ms.

ruledOut.title: Driver interrupt latency
ruledOut.reason: Kernel-mode time stayed at 0.7% (deferred calls and interrupts).
